panels.description: Adrian’s hidden workshop with Alex small among blueprints, mechanical models, water diagrams, analog gauges and riveted pre-Alpha pipes. A perfectly organized workbench holds the covered dormant Bi11bot and Adrian’s watch face down beside it. The robot has no amber pulse, no lit optics and no active display; only dust and ordinary warm workshop reflections. Keep upper-left open.
Alex turns the worn steel watch over, revealing Adrian’s engraved equation. Keep upper-right clear.
The chalkboard equation matches the watch engraving. Silent and unobstructed.
The covered robot remains completely still. Alex’s open hand reaches toward the sheet without touching it; the watch’s display is still dark. Keep the workbench clear.
